evidence: The substrates were n-type Si{1 0 0} wafers, which were 200 mm in diameter. These wafers did not undergo additional cleaning steps and they were covered with a thin native oxide. Approximately 20 g of each precursor was loaded into a bubbler, which was subsequently attached to the reactor so that the precursors could be used as required. The bubbler temperature was varied over the range 70–90 /C176C and the substrate temperature was 200 /C176C. The base pressure of the system was /C24 10 /C0 6 Torr.
